definitions.explanation: A secret word or phrase used to identify allies or gain entry. Historically used in military and security contexts.
A phrase adopted as the guiding principle or shared goal of a group or movement.

examples.japanese: {合言葉|あいことば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧」だ。
⟦{門番|もんばん}→門番：24463_monban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合言葉|あいことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げた→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧。
examples.english: I told the gatekeeper the password.

examples.japanese: {合言葉|あいことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Those who don't know the password cannot enter.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{安全第一|あんぜんだいいち}→安全第一：24120_anzendaiichi⟧」⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{合言葉|あいことば}だ。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合言葉|あいことば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧」だ。
examples.english: The team's rallying cry is 'give it your all.'

examples.japanese: 「⟦{変革|へんかく}→変革：12100_henkaku⟧」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{合言葉|あいことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A new initiative was launched under the rallying cry of 'reform.'

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合言葉|あいことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (set a password/motto)
- {合言葉|あいことば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧ (tell the password)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{合言葉|あいことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (with ~ as a motto/rallying cry)

USAGE:
The sense 1 usage (password) evokes historical or fantasy settings — guards at castle gates, secret societies, etc. For modern digital passwords, ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧ is the standard term. The sense 2 usage (motto/rallying cry) is common in modern Japanese, especially in business, sports, and community contexts.
